newsitem.title: CANADA: Teleglobe to offer C$100 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Teleglobe to offer C$100 mln debentures.

text.p: Teleglobe Canada Inc on Tuesday said it has signed an agreement to make a public offering of C$100 million of 8.0 percent 30-year unsecured debentures in Canada.
The company said net proceeds of the debenture issue will be used to refinance existing debt and for general corporate purposes.
Teleglobe Canada Inc. is a subsidiary of Teleglobe Inc.
The company said Canadian Bond Rating Service and Dominion Bond Rating Service have confirmed ratings of A for the issue.

Teleglobe said it signed an agreement with an underwriting group lead by Merrill Lynch Canda Inc. The group includes Goldman Sachs Canada Inc., Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc., RBC Dominion Securities Inc., ScotiaMcLeod Inc. and Casgrain & Company Limited.
